page_subtitle.id: Butuh bantuan terkait pesanan, pengiriman, atau pembayaran? Temukan jawaban cepat di sini.
page_subtitle.en: Need help with orders, shipping, or payment? Find quick answers here.

desc_track.id: Masuk ke akun Anda, buka menu riwayat pesanan, lalu pilih pesanan untuk melihat status pengambilan, pengiriman, dan penyelesaian.
desc_track.en: Log in to your account, open order history menu, then select order to view pickup, shipping, and completion status.

desc_payment.id: Kami mendukung pembayaran melalui transfer bank serta online payment gateway.
desc_payment.en: We support bank transfers, online payment gateway.

desc_return.id: Pengajuan pengembalian dapat dilakukan maksimal 7 hari setelah produk diterima, selama produk belum digunakan dan kemasan masih lengkap.
desc_return.en: Return requests can be made maximum 7 days after product is received, as long as product hasn't been used and packaging is still complete.

desc_need_help.id: Tim dukungan kami siap membantu Anda melalui halaman kontak untuk pertanyaan teknis atau konsultasi produk.
desc_need_help.en: Our support team is ready to help you through the contact page for technical questions or product consultation.
